title: Scribbling Squid
statement: Drifting through a tranquil tank of swaying golden kelp and softly glowing sea glass, this diminutive, pearlescent squid spends its hours gently nudging smooth pebbles into tidy constellations. Whenever a curious visitor peers through the glass, it ripples with thoughtful bands of amber and teal before puffing a tiny, curling loop of ink like a floating signature.
